study.name: study
study.description: Represents a funded research activity (e.g., NACC Clinical Core, NACC Imaging, CLARiTI).

member.name: member
member.description: A participant in the study. Can view study resources and access program-scoped dashboards.

admin.name: admin
admin.description: A study administrator. Can manage study resources, access all-sites-scoped dashboards, and inherits viewer access to child resources via hierarchical permissions.

research_center.name: research_center
research_center.description: Represents an organization that collects data for studies (e.g., UW, Mayo Clinic, UCSF).

member.name: member
member.description: A member of the research center. Can view center resources and access site-scoped dashboards linked to this center.

admin.name: admin
admin.description: A center administrator. Can manage center resources.

funding_agency.name: funding_agency
funding_agency.description: Represents an organization that funds studies (e.g., NIA).

member.name: member
member.description: A member of the funding agency. Can view funded study resources.

admin.name: admin
admin.description: A funding agency administrator. Can manage funding relationships.

associated_organization.name: associated_organization
associated_organization.description: A flexible organization type for entities with relationships to NACC. Extensible for future authorization requirements.

member.name: member
member.description: A member of the associated organization.

admin.name: admin
admin.description: An administrator of the associated organization.

community.name: community
community.description: Represents individual registrants who are not affiliated with a specific research center or study.

member.name: member
member.description: A community member. Can access general NACC resources.

data_pipeline.name: data_pipeline
data_pipeline.description: Datatype-specific data collections for ingest or distribution.

viewer.name: viewer
viewer.description: Can view pipeline data. Also granted via study_admin_access (hierarchical permission).

submitter.name: submitter
submitter.description: Can submit data to the pipeline.

parent_study.name: parent_study
parent_study.description: Links this pipeline to its parent study. Required for all pipelines. Enables hierarchical permissions.

parent_center.name: parent_center
parent_center.description: Links this pipeline to its parent research center. Required for center ingest pipelines; absent for study distribution pipelines.

study_admin_access.name: study_admin_access
study_admin_access.description: Resolves to admins of the parent_study. Not directly assignable.

validParentCombinations.description: Center ingest pipeline — ingests data from a specific center for a study.
Study distribution pipeline — ingests data from a study for distribution to centers.

dashboard.name: dashboard
dashboard.description: Visualization interfaces with scope-based access control.

viewer.name: viewer
viewer.description: Can view the dashboard. Also granted via computed relations (study_admin_access, site_viewer, all_sites_viewer, program_viewer).

parent_community.name: parent_community
parent_community.description: Links this dashboard to its parent community.

parent_study.name: parent_study
parent_study.description: Links this dashboard to its parent study.

parent_center.name: parent_center
parent_center.description: Links this dashboard to its parent research center.

study_admin_access.name: study_admin_access
study_admin_access.description: Resolves to admins of the parent_study.

site_viewer.name: site_viewer
site_viewer.description: Resolves to members of the parent_center.

all_sites_viewer.name: all_sites_viewer
all_sites_viewer.description: Resolves to admins of the parent_study.

program_viewer.name: program_viewer
program_viewer.description: Resolves to members of the parent_study.

page.name: page
page.description: Displayable portal endpoints such as webinar archives, training materials, and protocol documentation.

viewer.name: viewer
viewer.description: Can access the page. Also granted via community_viewer, study_admin_access, and center_viewer (hierarchical permissions).

parent_community.name: parent_community
parent_community.description: Links this page to its parent community.

parent_study.name: parent_study
parent_study.description: Links this page to its parent study.

parent_center.name: parent_center
parent_center.description: Links this page to its parent research center.

community_viewer.name: community_viewer
community_viewer.description: Resolves to members of the parent_community. Not directly assignable.

study_admin_access.name: study_admin_access
study_admin_access.description: Resolves to admins of the parent_study. Not directly assignable.

center_viewer.name: center_viewer
center_viewer.description: Resolves to members of the parent_center. Not directly assignable.

generic_resource.name: generic_resource
generic_resource.description: An extensible resource type for future needs. Supports basic viewer/editor/admin access control.

authorization_interface.name: authorization_interface
authorization_interface.description: Singleton resource representing the Authorization Interface itself. Role assignments on this resource control who can use the interface and what operations they can perform within it.

viewer.name: viewer
viewer.description: Global viewer — can perform read-only permission lookups for any resource in the interface.

admin.name: admin
admin.description: Global admin — can grant and revoke authorizations for any resource in the interface. Implies viewer.

scoped_viewer.name: scoped_viewer
scoped_viewer.description: Organization-scoped viewer — can perform read-only permission lookups within a specific organizational boundary. Requires org_scope condition context.

scoped_admin.name: scoped_admin
scoped_admin.description: Organization-scoped admin — can grant and revoke authorizations within a specific organizational boundary. Implies scoped_viewer. Requires org_scope condition context.
